name: ai-expression-detector
description: Browser-side facial expression detection with a MERN backend (learning/portfolio project).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
